data.summary: The superset directory contains container build definitions and configuration for setting up Apache Superset with Trino database connectivity.

file_insights.name: Dockerfile
file_insights.summary: Defines the container build process for custom Apache Superset deployment with Trino support.
file_insights.source_summary: Extends apache/superset:6.1.0, switches to root user to install trino[sqlalchemy]==0.339.0 using uv pip, and returns to superset user.
file_insights.detailed_description: This Dockerfile builds a custom Superset container image based on version 6.1.0, installs the Trino database driver with SQLAlchemy support via uv pip, and sets up the appropriate user context.
responsibilities: Installs Trino SQLAlchemy driver and client dependencies
